fields.raw_value: The High Line Park is a luxury condominium development located opposite Rajarajeswari Dental college on Bangalore-Mysore Expressway. The Property is being improved with a 11-story condominium tower. The tower includes 57 Class-A condominiums comprised of 11 two-bedroom, 22 three-bedroom, 11 four-bedroom and 2 Commercial Retail units. The Property also features a below grade parking garage with 65 car parking lots. The property boasts an amenity package with Co-working spaces, Community kitchen, Fitness centre, Indoor games & Swim pool. The property’s transit oriented location offers unparalleled access to transportation. Metro Phase-2 Purple line (Line-2) running from East to West is just a few meters away from the property location. Challaghatta metro station is within 5 min walking distance from the property.
